item.text: {"rule":"The procedure used a round-specific stay/leave decision at each stage: either the petted pair or the unpetted pair advanced, then either the petted or unpetted remaining cat won. Because identical selections produced different stay/leave outcomes across rounds, the observations are insufficient to infer what determined those decisions."}
